frontMatter.title: Weekly Badminton Round-Up: Cup Semi-Final Secured & Big League Matches Ahead
frontMatter.summary: A busy week of badminton with hard-fought draws, a Cup win on points for our Grade 6 Mens to reach the Semi-Final, and key league fixtures coming up. Note: No club night on Wednesday 4th March—adult club nights are Monday 2nd and Thursday 5th.

prev.title: Thursday Club Night + Grade 3 Ladies: Navan 'B' vs Ardee
prev.summary: Thursday Club Night: two courts from 9pm, an extra 30 minutes of play, and a Grade 3 Ladies clash as Navan 'B' take on Ardee.

next.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium: Match Night, Two Courts & Juvenile Club
next.summary: Monday Club Night is back in Claremont Stadium with Grade 7 Mens (Navan ‘B’ vs Drumree), two adult courts from 8:30pm, and Juvenile Club sessions for girls (6:30pm) and boys (7:30pm).
